entities.summary: Otto Ferdinand Muller von Czernicki, Jr was a Dutch field hockey player who competed in the 1928 Summer Olympics. He had a professional career as agricultural engineer, was married to Lilie van Thiel, and was the son of Otto Ferdinand Muller von Czernicki, Sr and Anna Catharina Cramer.
